subject: SIG questionnaire — artifact inventory & staged delivery plan
messages:
From: Alex Stone <alex.stone@novamed.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: security_ops@novamed.com
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: SIG follow-up + remaining artifacts

Neha —

Thanks for walking through the SIG earlier. We completed the questionnaire but the compliance team has asked for the remaining artifacts to close our review. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following items and an estimated delivery schedule?

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- Executive summary of the most recent penetration test (redacted is OK)
- ISO 27001 attestation / statements of applicability
- Security overview deck for our InfoSec review

A couple of notes from our side: we can accept redacted pen-test details if you have an internal process for that. Also, we prefer an S3/secure share link for downloads rather than email attachments.

Appreciate a one-week target if possible — our procurement window is tight.

Thanks,
Alex Stone
Senior Security Analyst
NovaMed Health
alex.stone@novamed.com

------------------------------------------------------------

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Stone <alex.stone@novamed.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up + remaining artifacts

Alex —

Thanks for the list and for the context. Below is an inventory of what we can provide immediately and our proposed staged delivery. We aim to minimize friction for procurement while protecting sensitive artifact contents.

Inventory & delivery schedule (proposed):
1) SOC 2 Type II report (covering period to 2026-09-30) — Delivery: 48 hours (PDF, watermarked).
2) Pen test executive summary (redacted vulnerability details) — Delivery: 72 hours (TXT/PDF).
3) ISO 27001 attestation (if requested, attestation letter + cert summary) — Delivery: 5 business days (PDF).
4) Security overview deck (updated security architecture + controls) — Delivery: 48–72 hours (PPTX).

Sharing model: for the pen-test and SOC 2 we will provide a watermarked PDF via a secure share link (expiration 14 days). For the pen test full report we require an executed mutual NDA or an existing confidentiality clause in your procurement docs — we can accept a signed DocuSign or your standard vendor NDA.

Next steps for us:
- I’ll upload SOC 2 and the security deck to a secure share and post the links here once ready.
- Rishi will review the pen test redaction and confirm whether we can share an extended summary without additional approvals.
- Monica will coordinate any procurement paperwork and confirm the DocuSign flow if needed.

If this staged approach works for NovaMed, I’ll target delivery by the end of Friday. Otherwise tell us which items to prioritize and we’ll accelerate.

Best,

Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

Neha —

- Is the SOC 2 report the full report or just a vendor snapshot? We need the auditor's opinion and control narrative sections.
- For the pen test, redacted exec summary is fine; can you confirm if the redaction will remove CVE identifiers or only internal IPs/hostnames?

If you can get SOC 2 first that would be ideal — we can review the deck afterward.

Regards,
Alex
